claims: Independently inspected the supplied Xcode PrivacyReport PDF using the PDF skill, Poppler metadata/text extraction and a rendered image of its only page.

The 807-byte PDF SHA256 is 9ac322434178fbf5c19a50dc6e0e4612bef0c6c36c7929251de908dbd98240c6. It renders entirely blank and yields no non-whitespace text. The page tree has zero-sized MediaBox and the decompressed stream contains graphics-state save/restore only, with no text or drawing content.

This document cannot be reconciled as an inspectable aggregate privacy report. The narrow PDF review therefore fails; a successful file save or valid PDF container does not establish meaningful report contents.

Separately re-read all four original Release archive privacy manifests against exact frozen source: they match, declare no tracking and no collected-data types, and retain their required-reason API declarations. Those existing package facts remain consistent with the coordinator-observed Data Not Collected position; they do not substitute for a populated Xcode report.
The source remains clean at exact31538ce. The PDF attempt and independent rendering/text/structural diagnostics are preserved without modifying the PDF, source or archive.
limitations: This is a failed narrow PDF review, not a finding of new data collection or a failed signed package. Broader store-materials review, external validation/upload/processing and privacy PDF generation remain distinct.
The verifier did not observe or operate Organizer generation, browser/App Store UI, devices or simulators. The cause of the blank PDF is not established here.
